name: Vidhva Vivah Uphar Yojana
eligibility_rules: Applicant must be a widow women from Rajasthan State. Applicant must be resident of Rajasthan or living in Rajasthan for 3 years before re-marriage. Applicant should be entitled to pension as per widow pension rules. Applicant age should be between 18-50 years. If the applicant has remarried before this scheme then he/she will not be eligible.
